title: Quickstart Starter-Path Hero with Anchored Checklist & Motion Tokens
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Scope: Design a refreshed Quickstart landing hero that centers a 'Starter Path' anchored checklist on the left and a dynamic product canvas on the right. The hero must communicate a 3-step first-time user flow (Sign up -> API key -> First request) without using full-screen walkthrough copy. Deliverables: Figma artboard with 3 responsive breakpoints, exported static PNG/WebP screenshots in light and dark themes, a Lottie-compatible motion spec for microanimations, a dev handoff token sheet (timing/curves/opacity), and an accessibility annotation layer. Goals: reduce time-to-first-api-call by 15% for new accounts and increase quickstart CTA clicks by 8% in the first two weeks after release. Constraints: must reuse existing color tokens and call out where new tokens are proposed (motion-duration-md, motion-ease-entrance). Engineering dependency for feature flag and screenshot endpoint implementation is tracked in ENG-5980.
acceptance_criteria: Figma file contains hero variants for desktop (1366+), tablet (768-1024), and mobile (<=375) with annotated layout grids
Exported screenshot pack (PNG + WebP) for light/dark with 2x and 3x assets uploaded to Drive
Motion spec exported as Lottie JSON + plain CSS keyframe fallback with documentation of timing and easing tokens
Design handoff includes a tokens sheet (spacing, font sizes, motion durations) and a checklist for engineering QA
A/B rollout plan and metric tracking events defined and approved by PM (events: quickstart_cta_click, first_api_call_time, quickstart_completion)
Accessibility: hero passes contrast checks, CTA has focus state, checklist accessible to screen readers (aria-expanded semantics documented)
